clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Old Town, Renzik "The Shiv" directs SI:7's new rogue recruits. The goblin is Spymaster Mathias Shaw's trusted second-in-command, receiving promising agents sent from across the Alliance.

Renzik keeps his past to himself. In Stormwind, he is known as a goblin who rose to become Spymaster Mathias Shaw's second-in-command in SI:7. He has little patience for pleasantries. When new recruits arrive, he asks whether they are ready to work or need a nap first.

Renzik works inside SI:7's secretive fortress in Old Town, second-in-command to Mathias Shaw. Rogue mentors across the Alliance, from Ironforge to Darnassus, send their most promising agents to him. He sends them to field instructors such as Lucius in Redridge, where they can hone the skills needed to survive in the field.
